title: Rig IDE Capability Receipt
description: Receipt for every IDE capability execution. Emitted by the capability broker after execution, regardless of success or failure. All fields content-light — no raw buffer content, secrets, or diffs.

workspace.description: Workspace path hash (SHA256 prefix, 16 chars). Not the full path.

capability.description: Capability name from the manifest (e.g. ide.workspace.describe)

input_sha256.description: SHA256 of the canonical JSON-serialized input arguments

output_sha256.description: SHA256 of the canonical JSON-serialized output result

agent_id.description: Agent identifier that requested the capability, if available

user_approved.description: Whether the user explicitly approved this execution

approval_method.description: How the approval decision was reached

mutated_workspace.description: Whether this execution mutated workspace state. 'possible' means it depends on context.

error.description: Error message if status is error or refused

workspace_trusted.description: Whether the workspace was trusted at time of execution
